questions.q: The configuration has `rates_type = ACTUAL`, `roll_rc_rate = 15`, `roll_srate = 60`, `roll_expo = 40`. What will Betaflight App show?
questions.explain: In the CLI rc_rate and srate are stored in tens of °/s, expo in hundredths: 150 / 600 / 0.40.

questions.q: An Actual 15/60/40 profile, the roll stick at half travel. What is the setpoint?
The simulator has only the Betaflight rate type. 1.50 / 0.60 / 0.40 was entered in the fields instead of Actual 150 / 600 / 0.40. What will you get at full stick?
questions.explain: The Betaflight type: maximum 200·r/(1 − s) = 200·1.5/0.4 = 750 °/s. Numbers are converted between types, not copied over.

questions.q: How does Acro differ from ANGLE with the right stick released?
options: In Acro the aircraft returns to level more slowly
In Acro the aircraft keeps its current tilt
In Acro the aircraft holds altitude
questions.explain: In Acro the stick sets the rotation rate; at center the rate is zero and the tilt remains. In ANGLE the stick sets the angle, and center is level.

questions.q: Why is a gamepad a poor fit for learning in a simulator?
options: A gamepad has no yaw axis
The throttle stick is spring-loaded, and the stick travel is short
A gamepad sends commands with a delay of more than a second
questions.explain: Simulators accept a gamepad, but the throttle on a radio does not return to center, and the stick travel is longer: muscle memory does not transfer.

questions.q: A turn with a 60° roll without losing altitude. By what factor must thrust grow compared with hover?
questions.explain: The vertical share of thrust is cos φ, so thrust 1/cos 60° = 2 times greater is needed.

questions.q: A light aircraft over an empty field at a height of 2 m has lost control and is flying into the ground. What do you do?
options: Turn on HORIZON and wait for it to level out
Let go of both sticks and wait
questions.explain: Near the ground over an empty field a disarm saves the motors and ESCs and keeps the propellers from spinning in the grass. Over people and at altitude the order is different — see the recovery reflex.

questions.q: When, by the course plan, do you move from the simulator to the next rung?
options: After 10 hours of flight time in the simulator
After 5 figure-eight laps in a row without a reset in two training sessions
After buying goggles and the first aircraft
When the exercises start to seem easy
questions.explain: The gate is a verifiable criterion. The sources name from 5 to 20 hours, but hours are only a time estimate.
